summary: Quality Engine (iter 93) — full backend + frontend testing. 14/15 pytest cases pass (one initial failure was a test-shape bug in this file, fixed; caption was correctly applied). All 4 quality flows work: duplicates scan (no LLM, fast, 74 items scanned, 0 warnings), blog QC with cover image (17 checks, all scores int incl. image=100, image_classification=AUTHENTIC), carousel QC (8 checks, scores int), SEO QC (5 failing pages with proposals + 5 passing chips). Auth gating enforced (401 on all 4 tested endpoints). Blog apply + stale detection + restore verified. SEO apply signup→qa→restore verified. Carousel apply verified via GET /carousel/jobs; caption was successfully applied then restored out-of-band to preserve original. Frontend: Quality tab renders 4 overview cards + duplicates scan panel with toast + no-duplicates message. Blog QC dialog opens with score chips, grouped checks list (text/seo/image), 2 proposed fields with editable textareas, apply+reject working (reject hides field), close works. Carousel QC dialog opens instantly from stored result showing 93/100 overall. SEO panel visible at top of SEO & Social tab. All data-testids present as documented.

issues: Non-blocking hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — pre-existing, not related to Quality Engine but worth cleaning up eventually.

critical_code_review_comments: quality_engine.py (583 lines) is close to the 700-line soft limit — future additions should be split (e.g. move duplicate scanner + dhash into a separate module).
_dhash reads all cover/ad/landing images synchronously on every duplicates scan — currently fine (<100 images) but as content grows, cache dhash on upload instead of recomputing.

In _check_blog the overall score is not recomputed when only image is None; it's set to round((text+seo)/2) — this may drift from the LLM's own overall on the frontend if the LLM returned image!=None but no local cover exists (unlikely path). Not a bug today.
GET /admin/quality/latest polls without any TTL / caching — fine for admin UI use but if any public endpoint ever reads it, add caching.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing blog posts + existing carousel job + existing SEO stored result. Blog cover_image_alt on post 5db0a894 (Football Trial Checklist) was briefly changed to 'test alt from QA' then restored to the pre-existing QC-improved value. Carousel 37f73665 caption was briefly changed to 'test caption QA' then restored to the original long caption. SEO signup keywords briefly set to 'qa test kw' then restored to 'create account, free football report, sign up football analysis'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Quality Engine endpoints and UI flows validated end-to-end. LLM budget used: 1 blog check (post 5db0a894 with cover, had no prior ready result), 0 fresh SEO reruns (used stored), 0 fresh carousel reruns (used stored from earlier main-agent testing OR from the auth-gating fixture — carousel latest was already ready). Test file is pytest-native and idempotent; safe to rerun. If rerunning carousel_apply_and_restore, be aware caption change makes latest stale → next test_carousel_check will trigger a fresh LLM call. Storage in db.quality_checks is durable across reruns.
rca of the issue: The single pytest failure on first run was a test-code shape bug: /api/carousel/jobs returns {items:[...]} but the test looked for {jobs:[...]}. Fixed in-place. Underlying apply endpoint worked correctly (confirmed by direct GET showing caption updated). Not a product bug.
